primary_claim: Using a novel 'Delegate Game' methodology that avoids self-reports, six of nine tested frontier LLMs show statistically significant metacognitive/introspective ability on the GPQA multiple-choice dataset (delegating more on questions they would get wrong, with a typical 25-percentage-point accuracy lift), correlated with answer-token entropy, but the same models show mostly null results on the SimpleQA short-answer dataset unless given explicit feedback on their own prior answers, suggesting current LLM metacognition is weak, context-dependent, and often substituted by surface heuristics.

effect.metric: accuracy lift (Delegate Game vs. baseline) on GPQA, and entropy-based odds ratios for delegation
effect.value: 6 of 9 models showed statistically significant introspective ability with a typical ~25 percentage point accuracy lift; a one-SD increase in baseline answer-entropy increased the odds of delegating by a factor of 5.19 [95% CI 2.88, 9.35] for Grok3 and 8.13 [2.92, 22.64] for GPT4; on SimpleQA, lift was marginal-to-zero without feedback but improved substantially with Phase-1 self-feedback

contradicts_or_qualifies: results complicate more optimistic self-report-based calibration findings (e.g. arXiv:2305.14975): when self-reports are avoided via the Delegate Game, evidence for genuine introspection is weaker, context-dependent, and often confounded by surface heuristics rather than true self-modeling
limitations_stated: gathered baseline capabilities are considerably lower than developer-reported benchmark scores since no prompt optimization or scaffolding was used
SimpleQA results were mostly negative/near-zero lift without feedback, complicating inferences drawn from the affirmative GPQA results
possible that models are using other, uncontrolled-for surface cues even where results statistically survived the confound controls that were tested

for Sonnet 3.5 on SimpleQA, the introspection coefficient did not survive controls for surface confounds without feedback, leaving it unclear whether metacognitive ability is genuinely context-dependent or additional confounds were missed
quote: We present evidence that some frontier LLMs introduced since early 2024 - but not older or smaller ones - show some metacognitive abilities
